response_port_unavailable.title: XGIMI command replies are unavailable
response_port_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant could not bind UDP port 16751, which {host} uses to acknowledge commands.

Commands are still sent, but the integration cannot tell whether the device accepted or rejected them. This usually means the official XGIMI app or another Home Assistant instance is already using that port.

Free the port and reload the integration to restore command confirmation.
